boundary: Post-collapse endpoint observation can distinguish assignments ex post, but a branch-conditioned readout is not thereby a legitimate pre-selection anchor.

explicit_distinguishing_formula.difference: C_v(Gamma b)-C_v(b)=(U_v-L_v)(1-2b_v), nonzero for a genuine two-endpoint gap

setup.global_action: Gamma toggles component origin a and every b_v
setup.quotient_coordinates: choose root r and d_v=b_v xor b_r for v!=r

theorem.complete_invariant: The rooted relative coordinates d_v are constant on Gamma-orbits and separate Gamma-orbits. Hence every exact complement-invariant function of the component branch assignment factors uniquely through the quotient coordinate d=(d_v).
theorem.full_registry: The full frozen registry does not factor through the quotient because individual completed endpoint values distinguish globally complementary assignments whenever PREV!=NEXT.
theorem.iff: GLOBAL_COMPLEMENT_IS_OBSERVATIONALLY_REDUNDANT_RELATIVE_TO_O iff every declared O satisfies O(Gamma(b))=O(b) for every feasible b.
theorem.maximal_fixed_subalgebra: Within the registry-generated exact observable algebra, the complement-invariant subalgebra is the fixed subalgebra A^Gamma={F:F∘Gamma=F}; on branch coordinates it is exactly the algebra of exact functions of rooted relative parities d plus branch-insensitive declared external/structural data.
theorem.relative_subalgebra: RELATIVE_XOR_OBSERVABLES and branch-insensitive structural truth certificates factor through the quotient.
